scope: Deferred aligned/native versus unaligned/locked atomic paths; target packed placement is asserted only by Naru. Explicit labeled aligned Clang oracles check operation semantics without claiming external misaligned helper interoperability.

The installed Clang resource macro puts its argument only inside sizeof. The independent oracle explicitly evaluates it once for the 7.1.4p1 function-macro argument contract; alternate source is never passed to Naru.

Atomic aggregate representation and lock-free properties are implementation-defined: Naru keeps a 3-byte value and uses its support lock. The independent oracle checks type consistency and once-only argument evaluation, without assuming Naru representation or result.
The generic operation takes an atomic object pointer. The installed reference macro only uses sizeof and does not enforce that source interface.

int main(void){return atomic_is_lock_free(0)==77?42:1;}

struct Fake{_Atomic _Bool _Value;};int main(void){struct Fake value={0};return atomic_is_lock_free(&value);}
cases.reference_note: Matching the resource header carrier layout does not make a distinct nominal C record an atomic type. The size-only reference macro does not check this interface.

int main(void){atomic_flag f=ATOMIC_FLAG_INIT;int atomic_flag_test_and_set=0;return atomic_is_lock_free(&f)&&atomic_flag_test_and_set==0?42:1;}

int main(void){atomic_flag f=ATOMIC_FLAG_INIT;{typedef int atomic_flag;atomic_flag n=0;return atomic_is_lock_free(&f)&&n==0?42:1;}}
